edge_explainer.market_believes: AI agents replace the seats ServiceNow bills — cut the multiple by a third and wait.
edge_explainer.we_believe: Four straight quarters of contracted bookings holding ~21% say the fear hasn't touched demand — and the AI product is ADDING a billion-dollar run-rate on top, corroborated (not contradicted) by the backlog. But it's premium software at a premium cash-flow multiple, the balance-sheet cushion just went to M&A, and backlog lags repricing by construction — so it's a 7, sized like one.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: The mirror thesis, cleanly instrumented: the same fear we're long against in services at 1-2x sales, tested here at its highest-quality expression — with the cRPO organic line as the single decisive tripwire.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: Some de-rate is WARRANTED — growth is normalizing to ~20% on law-of-large-numbers regardless of AI.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Jul-22 after close: cRPO cc >=19% rep / >=18% organic + FCF guide ~32% + the $1B Now Assist reaffirm + federal tone; then Q3 confirms noise-vs-trend.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Organic cRPO under 18% without an FX/federal story = the SAP lag arriving in the books — trim, don't argue.
